args.command:
br create --title "Implement first-match-wins semantics" --description "## Scope
Implement first-match-wins iteration semantics - the matcher should return on the first matching rule, not continue checking later rules.

## Implementation
1. Implement iteration over rules in order
2. Return immediately on first match (do not check remaining rules)
3. Ensure more-specific patterns can come before less-specific ones in the config
4. Add unit tests verifying that earlier rules win over later rules even when both would match

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] match_adapter returns on first matching rule, stops iteration
- [ ] Unit test demonstrates rule order matters (first match wins)
- [ ] cargo test passes" --label split-child
args.description: Create fourth child bead for first-match-wins

args.command:
br create --title "Add comprehensive unit tests and default fallback" --description "## Scope
Add comprehensive unit tests covering all edge cases and implement default fallback behavior.

## Implementation
1. Test empty rules list (should return None for default fallback)
2. Test no-match scenario (should return None)
3. Test invalid pattern gracefully fails (returns None or skips rule)
4. Verify default parameter is used correctly by caller on None return
5. Add tests for combination scenarios (regex + glob, first-match-wins)
6. Ensure cargo test passes with full coverage

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unit tests cover: empty rules, no match, invalid pattern, regex, glob, first-match-wins
- [ ] match_adapter returns None when no patterns match (caller uses default)
- [ ] Invalid patterns are handled gracefully (compile or match failure returns None)
- [ ] cargo test passes with all tests passing" --label split-child
